title: 第十五章 揽仙偶遇
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
一踏入揽仙楼后，远处仙乐背景响起，她心中一乐，就算修仙界也是带氛围的，楼内中空，呈巨大的环形，每一层皆是以灵木镶嵌灵玉为栏，回廊上设着雅座。

    无数发着微光的流萤在空中缓缓飘浮，空气中浮动着灵木的清香，小巧的傀儡机关来回跑动时伴随着嗡嗡声，大堂里，修士谈笑中夹杂着渺渺仙乐，谢清猗在侍者的招待下便上了楼。

    宴廊奉事额头滲出薄汗，沉声恭敬道：“楼主，雅间的那位仙子又增加了三十多道菜！”

    “一个人点这么多？你没弄错？”楼主捻着山羊胡，精明的眼睛不住往楼上瞟，手中折扇顿在半空。

    “千真万确！那位仙子尝了我推荐的菜，每样都要了一份！”宴廊奉事得意地挺起胸脯，腰间挂的传菜玉牌随着他的动作晃了一下。

    “怪哉，高阶大能或是仙府内门修士，向来不重口腹之欲，这位仙子衣着不凡，何况我见她腰间玉牌可是天极仙府的核心弟子，怎会这般，难道以前都是我想岔了？”楼主摇着折扇，满腹疑窦，目光扫过楼内浮动的清灵气韵。

    “定是咱家灵食太香！楼主，您就别琢磨了。”宴廊奉事露出酒窝笑道，随后又匆匆退了出去迎客，身影没入流光里。

    “怪哉，怪哉。”楼主摇着头踱向后院。

    帘外偶有流光划过夜空，那是晚归的修士御剑而过的痕迹。

    而此时雅间内，谢清猗幸福地眯起眼睛。室内陈设雅致，窗边垂着青纱，透过它可见楼下长街灯火蜿蜒延伸。

    谢清猗正捧着酱香四溢的鸡腿咬了一大口，外皮酥脆，内里滑嫩，咸香可口，她觉得自己快要被眼前的美食，感动得要落下泪来。

    呜呜呜太好吃了！天知道她这些日子对着辟谷丹想着美食都快馋疯了。

    这修仙界人人都餐风饮露，个个不食人间烟火，连带着让她，也觉得自己快一步升仙了。

    “要怪就怪这厨子手艺太好，绝不是我嘴馋。”谢清猗一边为自己开脱，一边又夹了块颤巍巍的水晶肴肉。那肉冻在筷尖轻晃，透着莹润的光泽，叫她忍不住咽了咽口水。

    谢清猗望着满桌珍馐，玉盘盛着灵气隐隐的清蒸灵鲈，碧玉碗里是琥珀色的灵菇炖汤，还有炸得金黄酥脆的不知名灵禽……

    眼底漾起惺惺相惜的暖意，这一刻，她特别能理解原身为何会在芥子袋里放锅碗瓢盆了，简直就是知音。

    待最后一道玲珑玉雪酥上桌，那点心同她在原世的很相似，只是除了入口即化，清甜不腻外，瞬息一抹微凉的灵力在体内游走，与其他灵食有所不同。

    想到刚才这个伙计就是这么舌灿莲花，将每道菜的渊源典故说得绘声绘色，让她不知不觉的点了好多。

    谢清猗再次听得入迷，忽然眉眼一弯，眸中映着桌上烛火暖光：“你说的我都要了。还有，把这些，照原样再备一份，我要带走。”

    “好的，仙子您且慢用，后厨立时准备，包管滋味分毫不差！”宴廊奉事眉眼带笑，想着今日这赏钱定然丰厚，乐颠颠地退下，脚步声在木楼梯上嗒嗒作响。

    恰巧楼主捧着新到的瑞雪茶从后门进来，就听见堂倌拖着长调朝灶间喊：“照先前的席面再整一套，全要装食盒！”
content_en:
As soon as she stepped into the Immortal Building, fairy music sounded in the background in the distance, and she felt happy. Even the world of cultivating immortals had an atmosphere. The building was hollow and in the shape of a huge ring. Each floor was made of spiritual wood inlaid with spiritual jade as railings, and there were elegant seats in the corridor.

    Countless glowing fireflies floated slowly in the air, and the fragrance of spiritual trees floated in the air. The small puppet mechanism was accompanied by a buzzing sound as it ran back and forth. In the lobby, the monks talked and laughed with subtle fairy music. Xie Qingyi was greeted by the waiter and went upstairs.

    A thin layer of sweat broke out on the forehead of the waiter in the banquet hall, and he said respectfully in a deep voice: "Master, the fairy in the elegant room has added more than thirty dishes!"

    "One person ordered so many? Are you not mistaken?" The host twirled his goatee, his shrewd eyes kept glancing upstairs, and the folding fan in his hand paused in the air.

    "It's absolutely true! The fairy tasted the dishes I recommended and ordered a portion of each!" The banquet attendant proudly puffed up his chest, and the jade plaque hanging around his waist swayed with his movements.

    "It's strange. High-level powerful men or monks from the inner sect of the Immortal Palace have never paid much attention to food and drink. This fairy's clothes are extraordinary. Besides, I saw the jade medal on her waist. She is a core disciple of the Tianji Immortal Palace. How could it be like this? Could it be that I was wrong in the past?" The building owner shook his folding fan, full of doubts, and glanced at the clear aura floating in the building.

    "It must be because our spiritual food is so delicious! Master, don't think about it." The waiter in the banquet hall said with a dimpled smile, and then hurriedly retreated to greet the guests, and his figure disappeared into the stream of light.

    "That's weird, that's weird." The host shook his head and walked towards the backyard.

    Occasionally, there is light streaking across the night sky outside the curtain, which is the trace of the monk who returned home at night passing by with his sword.

    At this time, in the elegant room, Xie Qingyi narrowed his eyes happily. The interior furnishings are elegant, and green gauze hangs by the windows. Through it, you can see the lights of the long street stretching downstairs.

    Xie Qingyi was holding a chicken leg that was full of sauce and took a big bite. It was crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, salty and delicious. She felt that she was about to shed tears because of the delicious food in front of her.

    Woohoo! It’s so delicious! God knows that she has been going crazy these days thinking about delicious food while looking at Bigu Dan.

    Everyone in this world of cultivating immortals was enjoying the wind and drinking the dew, and no one could eat the fireworks of this world. Even she felt that she was about to become an immortal in one step.

    "If I'm to blame, it's because the cook is so good at his craftsmanship. It's definitely not because I'm greedy." Xie Qingyi excused himself while picking up another piece of trembling crystal meat. The meat jelly swayed lightly on the tip of the chopsticks, showing a bright luster, which made her swallow her saliva.

    Xie Qingyi looked at the table full of delicacies. The jade plate contained the steamed spirit seabass with faint aura, the jasper bowl contained the amber spirit mushroom stew, and the unknown spirit bird was fried to a golden crisp...

    There was a warmth of sympathy in her eyes. At this moment, she could understand why the original person put pots and pans in the mustard bag. She was like a close friend.

    When the last piece of exquisite jade snow cake was served, it was very similar to the one in her original life, except that it melted in the mouth, was sweet and not greasy, and a slight cool spiritual power circulated in the body in an instant, which was different from other spiritual foods.

    Thinking that the waiter just now was so eloquent and told the origins and allusions of each dish vividly, she ordered a lot of them without knowing it.

    Xie Qingyi listened fascinated again, and suddenly his eyebrows curved, his eyes reflected the warm light of the candle on the table: "I want everything you said. Also, prepare another copy of these as they are, I want to take them away."

    "Okay, Fairy, please wait a moment. The kitchen will prepare it immediately to ensure that the taste is exactly right!" The waiter in the banquet hall smiled, thinking that today's reward would be generous, and he stepped back happily, his footsteps clicking on the wooden stairs.

    It happened that the host came in from the back door with the newly arrived Ruixue tea, and he heard the waiter shouting in a long tone toward the kitchen: "Make the same table as before, and put all the food boxes in it!"
title_en: Chapter 15 An encounter with the Immortal
